CustomField.description: Country of the address used for tax-jurisdiction resolution. Trigger field for the Taxation address override: when non-null at this level (Quote/Order/Account), the five Taxation fields are passed atomically to the tax engine as the destination address, overriding the default ship-to chain.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Country of the address used for tax calculation. When populated, the Taxation address (Street, City, State, Postal Code, Country) overrides the default ship-to address for tax calculation.
CustomField.label: Taxation Country
